title: 结构化权威注入：通过类型化MCP覆盖实现LLM智能体的持久人类控制
summary: 提出结构化权威注入（SAI）协议，通过类型化、模式校验的MCP工具调用传递操作员指令，并在每次提示前附加排序权威上下文，定义约束、优先级、策略三类覆盖及显式优先顺序。无需微调，在九个LLM和八个场景中减少指令歧义与权威衰减，最强模型提示开销降低最多38%。
summary_en: Proposes Structured Authority Injection (SAI), a protocol routing operator corrections through typed, schema-validated MCP tool calls with a ranked authority context prepended to each prompt. It defines Constraint, Priority, and Strategy override classes with explicit precedence via a directed authority channel. Requires no fine-tuning; across nine LLMs and eight scenarios it reduces ambiguous directive interpretation and authority decay, cutting prompt overhead up to 38% in strongest models.
